facts.fact: Haryana Old Age Samman Allowance is Rs 3,200 per month with effect from 01-11-2025
Before that it was Rs 3,000 per month from 01-01-2024

facts.quote: The person is of age 60 years or more;

facts.fact: Eligibility: domicile and resident of Haryana, with own plus spouse's income from all sources not above Rs 3,00,000 a year
facts.quote: The person is domicile and resident of Haryana State; and his/her combined income from all sources along with that of his/her spouse does not exceed Rs. 3,00,000/- per annum.

facts.fact: People receiving a pension from any Government, local or statutory body, or an organisation substantially financed by one, are not eligible
facts.quote: any person receiving pension from any Government or Local/ Statutory Body or any organization substantially financed by any Government or Local/ Statutory Body will not be eligible to receive allowance under the scheme.

facts.fact: The scheme runs proactively through Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPN): residents reaching the age are identified from verified FIDR data and asked to give consent
facts.quote: At the start of each quarter, residents reaching eligibility age are identified using verified FIDR data and added to the beneficiary roster shared with the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment. Newly added beneficiaries simply confirm their consent in response to official notifications.

facts.fact: After consent, the monthly allowance is paid into the verified bank account linked with the PPN
facts.quote: Upon confirmation, monthly allowance payments are disbursed directly into your verified bank account linked with PPN.

facts.fact: It can also be applied for on Saral Haryana through the 'Old Age Samman Allowance' service (Social Justice & Empowerment)
facts.quote: Apply For Service Old Age Samman Allowance Service Details are: Service is defined by the - LINE DEPARTMENT - Social Justice & Empowerment

facts.fact: The Saral Haryana service page does not show the allowance amount
facts.quote: What will Applicant get as Service Deliverable? The applicant will receive Output Certificate/Report as the service deliverable(s).
facts.note: Derived: a negative claim; the whole Saral service page (1,818 characters on 28 Oct 2026) was read and gives no rate; the amount is on the SJE Haryana pages.

summary: Rs 3,200 w.e.f. 01-11-2025 still current on SJE Haryana (scheme PDF and rate history); eligibility, exclusion, PPP proactive route and Saral service all confirmed; expected answer unchanged.
